semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Immutable minimum requirements with optional employer additions based on environmental and social assessments.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: The core contractual constraint regarding the modification of minimum requirements, specifically within the context of Employer notes in a proposal template.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Establishes the baseline non-negotiable terms while granting conditional authority to the Employer to expand upon them via assessment-driven additions.
